name: map-estate

name: proposals-ontology
what: Larkspur's tour, Wed Feb 7 (the normal day): the Data model's rules and files (the Ontology page as it was) with backup_jobs open; under it, Proposed from the data (ADR 0022 §5, Q-139, Q-213): the controller column's four values, a band for the last job's common value and the recovery point's three values, each saying what it rests on and what accepting it does, with Accept… and Not now for the owner

pageText: Each is listed as one of its codes, meaning itself until someone words it.
Bands for the common value of Last job
Each band is its usual range five points either side. A day outside one holds the day, by the values check.
